description: Self-test fixture: a smooth roofed Nether floor at 70 ± 18 under a lava sea at 74, nether wastes taking the drowned floor as its sea (basalt deltas grows columns out of the lava, which would read as dry floor), deep dark bound 8 blocks below the floor, and a fog held over the biomes, for the terrain section's roofed biomes line.
